newsitem.title: UK: UK's MMC report on TransCo due Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: UK's MMC report on TransCo due Wednesday.

text.p: Industry regulator Ofgas said it will release on Wednesday the report from the Monopolies and Mergers Commission on the watchdog's price control review of TransCo, the gas transport unit of BG Plc.
The MMC started its probe in October after BG, then called British Gas, rejected the Ofgas' proposals as too severe.

There has been recent press speculation that the MMC, which has remained tightlipped, has adopted a more lenient stance. Ofgas is, however, not obliged to accept the MMC's findings, although industry analysts widely expect it will.
Ofgas proposed a one-off 20 percent cut in TransCo's charges to gas suppliers in the first year and 2.5 percent in the following four years.
This would result in a cut in the average domestic gas bill by about 28 pounds in the first year the proposals would come into effect.
BG said implementation of the proposals would trim cash flow by an annual 400 million stg, while it preventing it from maintaining an efficient and safe pipeline network.
Analysts expect that BG will have to cut its year dividend to about five to nine pence per share from 14.50 pence last year whatever the definite outcome of the pricing review process.
